SUNRIDGE SOLAR WHOLESALE — OPERATIONS POLICY
Synthetic demo document. Effective 1 September 2026. Currency: USD.

Commercial terms: Standard wholesale payment terms are Net 45, measured from the invoice issue date. A 2 percent early-payment discount applies only when full payment is received within 10 calendar days. The minimum wholesale purchase order value is $500.

Warranty: Solar panels carry a 10-year product warranty and a separate 25-year performance warranty. Inverters have a 5-year product warranty. Battery packs have a 3-year product warranty. Warranty claims require the serial number and purchase invoice.

Fulfillment: Standard dispatch is within 3 business days after credit approval. Freight is quoted separately and is not included in merchandise revenue. The escalation reference is SSW-OPS-42.

Reporting definitions: The solar wholesale database contains customers, products, orders, and order_items. total_amount is the full merchandise value of an order. Delivered revenue is the sum of total_amount for delivered orders only. Pending and cancelled orders are excluded from delivered revenue. Products are Solar Panel, Inverter, Battery Pack, Charge Controller, Mounting Kit, and Cable Kit.

The document contains no tax advice, exact current inventory balance, cash collection dates, customer personal email addresses, or future sales forecast. Those answers require additional evidence.
